[31mstep/deliver: --evidence tests=suite.log holds the line `fr-scope: advisory — not deliver evidence`: it is not the whole suite. A session prints it when it ran with --fr-scope, a non-empty -m or -k (the default local run's -m 'not scenario' included), explicit paths or from a subdirectory, --lf, --sw, --ignore/--ignore-glob/--deselect, -x/--maxfail, -o testpaths= or --collect-only; the line before it in the log, `fr-scope: advisory because ...`, names which. Run the full suite with `pytest -m ""` into a log and name that file, or offer `tests: ci`.[0m
